title: Tough marries Casey Majors after Philadelphia show
summary: In 1937 with Tommy Dorsey at Nixon's Grand in Philadelphia, Tough and Freeman fall for chorus girls and Tough marries Casey Majors, who got him off drink for three years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yes, he was married. We were playing with Tommy Dorsey, this was now 1937 and we were playing at a black theatre called the Nixon's Grand Theatre in Philadelphia and in the chorus, it was a black chorus, as you know, and a black pit band, marvelous band and of course, marvelous black dancers, but we were the attraction because Tommy had become a big thing and we sold the theatre out, and there were great comedians like Pigment Markham and he and I became friends and there was a little gin mill that we used to go in a back alley behind the theatre the whole show would go every day.

Now, I went to the bandleader of the Sunset Royal Band and I said, 'Would you mind very much if we dated the girls. We're going to be here a week and we'd love to take them out.' And the man said, 'Go ahead,' there was no jealousy, he was so nice about it, and he said, 'Go ahead, it's cool, great, we're glad,' because there wasn't too much of that going on and it hadn't really begun, so we, Dave Tough and I fell madly in love with two lovely girls in the show, and Dave married his lady friend and my lady friend later was to marry and Englishman and I think she is living somewhere here in the U.K.
I don't think London, but I think she is living somewhere in the country and it was --
Casey Majors. She was a darling little girl. And she was so marvelous for him. He quit drinking for three years because of her, because she straightened him out.
And I remember later when Dave was in terrible trouble, Casey would go all over the city and find him and rescue him.
She was marvelous. She was a lovely little thing.
She really loved him, didn't she?
She really loved him and he loved her.
